summary: Short kerb on a quiet cul-de-sac bend, houses close on both sides.
reasons: Homes within about 25 m all round
Quiet residential street, one car parked

best_section.where: east kerb of St Andrews Place on the bend, beside the parked car

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb at roughly 12-14 m on the east side and across the street; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, kerb is wide enough for a van; one car already parks here.
drivers.traffic: Residential cul-de-sac, very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Quiet street with no camping convention; residents would notice a van.

flags: Houses at 12-14 m, tagged only as buildings
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees and hedge shade the east side in the morning.
